pages.text: The pure-white Mikazuki Munechika. ...Just who is He, now?

pages.name: White Mikazuki Munechika
pages.text: The boss of the White Night Garden dimension. A white Mikazuki Munechika who, for unknown reasons, fell into a loop. After a series of events, he chose to leave his Saniwa — a special blade.

Defeating White Mikazuki Munechika drops a large amount of Bottles o' Enchanting, Gold Omamori, Supreme Amulets, and one White Mikazuki Munechika. Normally, after defeating him once, he cannot be summoned a second time.

pages.title: Current Mechanics [Incomplete]
pages.text: White Mikazuki Munechika has up to 100,000 HP. His normal attack is only 55, but still lethal enough: when he attacks a player, he applies one stack of [Moon Shadow]. When the stacks reach 5, the player dies instantly.

pages.title: Current Mechanics [Incomplete]
pages.text: Using an Amulet can clear the stacks and prevent death. White Mikazuki Munechika has a blocking and damage-reflection mechanic. While blocking, he is immune to non-true damage and reflects it back. When a player flees from him, he teleports to the player's side to attack.

pages.title: Current Mechanics [Incomplete]
pages.text: When White Mikazuki Munechika enters a phase transition, he summons eight History Retrograde Army monsters. In the current version, his summon method in Survival Mode has not been implemented — he can only be summoned via commands.
